Definition: from G2413 and G4172; holy city; Hierapolis, a place in Asia Minor:--Hierapolis.
BiblicalUsage: Hierapolis is a place in Asia Minor, named once in Scripture, in Colossians. The full story of the place lives in the Bible itself, and this study covers only the name’s use.
TheologicalSignificance: I take Hierapolis seriously as a real place in God’s story, not a made-up one. That is why its name belongs in this study, even when the Bible says little about it.
